nodes.meaning: Actual density measurability/nonnegativity, finite product square-root algebra, and coordinate integral transport
For natural d,n with 3<=n<=d, let k=floor(d/n) and r=d-kn. Then k>=1, k*n<=d, d=k*n+(d%n), d%n=d-k*n=r.
From k*n<=d and r=d-k*n, exactly one of (k*n<d and r>0) or (k*n=d and r=0) holds. No k*n>d case remains.
For either source sign b, the actual conditioned law mu_n,b equals 2 times full Haar restricted to det O=b, since that component has mass 1/2. This is a probability measure.

For actual O in O(n) and kappa>=4, Eq4 gives a real symmetric positive precision A_O. The normalized Euclidean Gaussian density sqrt(det A_O)/(2*pi)^(n/2) * exp(-x^T A_O x/2) is an everywhere nonnegative measurable unit-mass Lebesgue density of the actual N(0,A_O^{-1}). The real n/2 exponent and Euclidean reference volume are retained.
